## Build/Upload Baseline
### Captain-v2 project (primary)
- Default environment: captain_control
- Serial upload port: COM5
- Known-good command:

```powershell
cd "c:\Users\user\Esp32 projects VScode\Captain-Fantastic-home-edition\Captain-v2"
C:\Users\user\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe run -e captain_control -t upload --upload-port COM5
```

### Important
- Avoid running monitor and upload in the same busy shared terminal at the same time.
- Prior failures during this session were mostly interrupted uploads (KeyboardInterrupt), not firmware compile failures.

## Known Issues / Watch Items
1. Matrix board I2C response was previously missing at address 0x24 in at least one boot log.
2. Tilt input (GPIO34) is noisy/floating in current hardware state and may spam press/release logs.
3. Root project upload task (combined_rtos) has failed intermittently and is not the preferred path for Captain-v2 control firmware work.

## Current Behavior Design
- Attract mode is deterministic pulse-chase timing.
- Attract-mode loop was adjusted to avoid matrix I2C workload interference while attract is active.
- OTA visual mode blinks all headbox lamps and score display while OTA transfer is in progress.
